purpose: Fast preflight memory for V5.1. Add a new rule whenever a run discovers a failure that should be prevented before expensive historical downloads or model execution.

lessons.lesson: External news feeds may expose Date rather than date.
lessons.guard: Normalize external CSV column names before validation and model ingestion.

lessons.lesson: A single malformed historical option quote must not abort an otherwise valid multi-year research run.
lessons.guard: Keep the economic payoff invariant, but isolate and record PAYOFF_INVARIANT_FAILED observations.

lessons.lesson: Never start multi-hour data acquisition/backtesting before cheap static and structural checks pass.
lessons.guard: Independent inspector must complete before the backtest job can start.

lessons.lesson: The V5.1 workflow must execute the guarded runner rather than the raw research runner.
lessons.guard: Inspector blocks any direct python v5/run.py execution as the production research step.

lessons.lesson: Feature names and external-series identifiers can drift and silently produce NaNs.
lessons.guard: Inspector checks known external-key mappings and the safe runner repairs legacy raw Yahoo-symbol lookups.

lessons.lesson: A green compute step is not enough; research artifacts must satisfy structural and economic invariants.
lessons.guard: Post-run validation checks required files, one-lot constraints, payoff bounds and six walk-forward windows.

lessons.lesson: Context/news must remain point-in-time and never be future-filled.
lessons.guard: Inspector checks the as-of cutoff implementation and workflow architecture; post-run review remains mandatory.

lessons.lesson: A feature that is completely unavailable throughout historical training windows must never be silently handed to an imputer or treated as valid historical information.
lessons.guard: Inspector enforces an explicit disabled-feature list for unsupported FII/DII/PCR flow fields until a validated point-in-time historical source covers the walk-forward horizon.
